_meta.description: Six competency domains for STM31733 Network Administration mapped from official course syllabus

domains.label: Network Administration Fundamentals
domains.description: Understanding of network administration concepts, roles, responsibilities, NOC functions and best practices

domains.label: Network Device Infrastructure
domains.description: Knowledge of VLAN types, routing protocols (Static, RIPv2, OSPF, EIGRP), server concepts and NOS

domains.label: Network Configuration
domains.description: Practical ability to configure switches, routers, VLANs, trunks, inter-VLAN routing, DHCP and DNS

domains.label: Network Troubleshooting
domains.description: Ability to systematically diagnose and resolve network issues using Ping, Traceroute, Netstat, Nslookup and Ipconfig

domains.label: Network Monitoring & Security
domains.description: Understanding and configuration of network monitoring protocols (SNMP, SSH, Telnet) and monitoring tools

domains.label: Professional Practice & Communication
domains.description: Ability to collaborate, present, document and discuss network monitoring findings professionally

mastery_levels.label: Not Started
mastery_levels.description: No activity recorded for this skill

mastery_levels.label: Novice
mastery_levels.description: Basic awareness but unable to apply independently

mastery_levels.label: Developing
mastery_levels.description: Beginning to apply skills with significant guidance

mastery_levels.label: Competent
mastery_levels.description: Can apply skills independently in familiar situations

mastery_levels.label: Proficient
mastery_levels.description: Applies skills confidently and handles complex situations

mastery_levels.label: Expert
mastery_levels.description: Mastery level — able to teach and troubleshoot at expert level
